snippet.title: SILVER STATE - Game Trailer (PICO-8)
snippet.description:
*FLASHING LIGHT WARNING*
https://maredjurphy.itch.io/silverstate
When Ysabel finds her brother dead with a strange crucifix-like structure attached to him, she finds herself compelled to take revenge on the humans that murdered him.

This is my fifth game, and my first game made in PICO-8! I'm having a lot of fun working with the fantasy console's unique features and restrictions while still making something that feels like "me."
